title: equisetum ramosissimum var. nudum
intro: Equisetum ramosissimum var. nudum, commonly known as the Shore Horsetail, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating kidney stones, urinary tract infections, and inflammation due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Equisetum ramosissimum var. nudum include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
